posts.body:
Foxy's Casino​
A collection of mini casino and card games for RPG Maker MZ. All games have customizable payouts. This plugin uses emojis instead of graphical assets. The emojis used are customizable.
Key Features
Mobile/touch-friendly
Controller friendly
Keyboard friendly
Easily customizable
Currently, there are the following games
Poker: 5-card poker with optional wilds
Slots: 3 row slots
Roulette: Standard roulette wheel
Blackjack: Standard Blackjack vs the table
Baccarat: Standard Baccarat
Hi-Lo: Guess if the next card will be higher or lower
War: Bet if your next card is higher than the dealers
Craps: Standard craps
Three Card Poker: 3-card power, will you get a better hand than the dealer
Free for personal and commercial use.
AI Disclosure
: AI was used to help generate some code and for debugging.
